description: CA · Manufacturing · rotamac.ca Rotamac Inc. is a privately held industrial equipment distributor founded in November 2019 and based in Rosemère/Montreal, Quebec, Canada (283 rue de Normandie, Rosemère, QC J7A 1T4). It is a micro company of 1–10 employees, essentially built around owner-founder Joey Desrosiers (HEC Montréal, 20+ years in compressed air and rotating equipment).
